name: ElasticSwap Exchange removeLiquidity decay accounting
summary: ElasticSwap Exchange.removeLiquidity paid out quote tokens pro rata of the live balance but debited that payout from the internal quote reserve with a zero clamp. Attackers took about half the LP supply, donated quote tokens directly to the exchange, removed liquidity to collapse the internal reserve, then swapped against the broken curve to drain the base token.
notes: Merged: about ten minutes later a different party ran the same exploit on ElasticSwap's Ethereum AMPL/USDC Exchange 0xa0c5aa50 (same factory template, deployed by 0x540b5182, age 18747657 s); it is a campaign entry and its assets carry chainId 1.

TIC has no market price at the time; it is valued at what the attacker realised, 8015.17 AVAX for 40608.26 TIC in its sale transaction (the refs entry), applied to the full TIC that left the exchange.
The Ethereum attacker was an AMPL arbitrage bot whose earlier calls through the same contract did not deplete the exchange; only its exploit transaction is counted.
